facts.text: The hotel is composed of two buildings: a restored 1934 Palace and the contemporary Posadas building.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is composed of two buildings, offering distinct settings: a restored 1934 Palace with timeless elegance, and the Posadas building, of contemporary style and modern design.

facts.text: The hotel is in the Recoleta neighborhood of Buenos Aires.
facts.excerpt: Situated in Buenos Aires

facts.text: Paseo de las Artes Duhau is an underground art gallery at the hotel showing temporary exhibitions.
facts.excerpt: Discover Paseo de las Artes Duhau, an underground art gallery showcasing dynamic, temporary exhibitions and creative expressions.

facts.text: The hotel's gardens are surrounded by ancient trees and have a cascading fountain.
facts.excerpt: Find tranquility in our hotel

facts.text: Ahin Spa has a short-course swimming pool and a gym.
facts.excerpt: With a short-course swimming pool, a high-end gym and an expert team, Ahín Spa offers an unparalleled escape for rejuvenation and well-being.

facts.text: Duhau Restaurante serves signature Argentine cuisine with wood-fired cooking and is recognized by the Michelin Guide.
facts.excerpt: in this restaurant recognized by the Michelin Guide

facts.text: La Vinoteca has a cheese cellar and offers wine and cheese tastings.
facts.excerpt: La Vinoteca completes the experience with a distinctive cheese cellar and curated wine and cheese tastings that explore local terroirs and refined pairings.

facts.text: Los Salones del Piano Nobile has original frescoes and boiserie and serves a traditional afternoon tea.
facts.excerpt: With large windows, oak floors, original frescoes and boiserie, the restaurant offers a distinguished atmosphere that evokes historical charm.

facts.text: Oak Bar has medieval oak paneling and a garden-view terrace, serving cocktails, Scotch whiskies and tapas.
facts.excerpt: With its medieval oak paneling, Oak Bar offers a unique experience inspired by timeless elegance.

facts.text: Gioia Cocina Botanica serves Italian cuisine rooted in sustainability and is recognized by the Michelin Guide.
facts.excerpt: Discover Gioia Cocina Botanica at Park Hyatt Buenos Aires and immerse yourself in a contemporary culinary journey rooted in sustainability and recognized by the Michelin Guide.

facts.text: Gioia Cocina Botanica has a plant-based menu.
facts.excerpt: sources ingredients from local producers to create a plant-based menu centered around legumes, seaweed, fungi, fruits and plants

facts.text: Duhau Patisserie is the hotel's pastry boutique, offering macarons and petits gateaux.
facts.excerpt: from elegant macarons to a curated selection of sweets and delicate petits gâteaux

facts.text: The hotel has a flower boutique, Floreria del Duhau, which also welcomes visitors from the community.
facts.excerpt: This charming space creates stunning floral arrangements for the hotel

facts.text: Palace rooms include butler service.
facts.excerpt: Butler service

facts.text: Butlers unpack on arrival, press clothes and shine shoes at no charge.
facts.excerpt: Your butler will unpack for you upon arrival, press your clothes and shine your shoes, all at no charge.

facts.text: The hotel welcomes housebroken dogs, providing a bed, bowl and treats.
facts.excerpt: We offer a bed, a dog bowl and treats in your suite or room. All dogs must be housebroken.

facts.text: Valet parking includes private VIP parking with direct access to the Palace suites.
facts.excerpt: including private VIP parking that provides direct access to the Palace suites

facts.text: Ezeiza International Airport is 34 kilometers from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Ezeiza International Airport (EZE)34 kilometers

facts.text: Aeroparque Jorge Newbery is 7.1 kilometers from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Aeroparque Jorge Newbery (AEP)7.1 kilometers

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler describes the hotel as a neoclassical mansion from the 1930s that has been restored.
facts.excerpt: In one of the poshest corners of Recoleta is this neoclassical mansion from the 1930s that has been impeccably restored.

facts.text: In-room dining is available 24 hours.
facts.excerpt: with our 24-hour in-room dining service

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler lists the hotel on its Gold List 2018 and 2019.
facts.excerpt: Gold List 2018, 2019

facts.text: The hotel calls Ahin Spa one of the city's most exclusive wellness retreats.
